 CIO Greatest Hits: Endowments – Scott Wilson (WashU) Jul 21, 2025

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Our Summer Series kickoff is a twofer, Andy
Golden, now retired after thirty years at Princeton University
Investment Management Company, and Scott Wilson from Washington
University-St. Louis. We packaged these two leading endowments to
compare their investment styles. 

  

 Scott comes from a direct investing background
and has adopted a position-focused approach to diligence and
co-investing, leading to a very different portfolio construction.
It’s perhaps the leading example of a new approach in the endowment
world.

October 4, 2020

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
